question:
Generate a molecule that contains the following substructure, described as a medicinal-chemistry structural constraint:

"A benzoxazinone core-a six-membered aromatic ring with one nitrogen and one oxygen, ortho-fused to a benzene and bearing a lactone carbonyl-is directly linked through a biaryl bond to a second benzene ring. The attachment on the benzoxazinone side is at the ring carbon adjacent to the nitrogen."

In addition, the molecule must satisfy ALL of the following target molecular properties — each computed value must fall within the stated range (values stated exactly must be matched exactly):
  - a molecular weight (MW) between 257 and 427.1 Da
  - a topological polar surface area (TPSA) between 81.6 and 99.4 Å²
  - a drug-likeness score (QED) between 0.448 and 0.548
  - a molar refractivity (MR) between 69.4 and 86.9
  - a distribution coefficient (logD) between 2.19 and 2.92
  - an aqueous solubility (logS) between -5.86 and -4.48
  - a blood-brain-barrier penetration score (BBBP) of at least 0.955
  - a mutagenicity score (Mutag) of at least 0.745

Return a single SMILES string for one molecule that BOTH contains this substructure AND satisfies every target property listed above (all values within their ranges).
